body:
Exact command: `gh pr edit 79 --body-file /tmp/pr79body.md` in a repo (a private repo of mine, name redacted) that still has a classic project attached.

Observed: the edit fails outright with

```
GraphQL: Projects (classic) is being deprecated in favor of the new Projects experience, see: https://github.blog/changelog/2024-05-23-sunset-notice-projects-classic/. (repository.pullRequest.projectCards)
```

The mutation apparently queries `repository.pullRequest.projectCards`, and GitHub now returns an error for that field on repos with classic projects, making `gh pr edit` unusable there.

Expected: `gh pr edit` should not fail when the caller is not touching projects — the projectCards lookup should be skipped, tolerate the deprecation error, or fall back to the REST PATCH (`PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{n}`), which works (verified as the workaround).

gh version tested: whatever ships in the current ZCode/agent environment on Ubuntu (linux amd64), 2026-10-08.
title: gh pr edit fails with 'GraphQL: Projects (classic) is being deprecated' on repos with classic projects
